planComparison: Partial original R-2, zero original-card completion credit. This extension preserves existing owner-only preview/read_only project pass constraints while implementing a configurable persisted 1..60 minute quota and accurate 429 Retry-After, including two-adapter PostgreSQL concurrency and revocation proof. R-2 still lacks general RTC 2 authenticated write route, full R-1 pass scope, direct-client and provider acceptance, exact deployed provenance and independent development/customer sign-in validation. Existing frozen original eight criteria are unchanged, and no live provider/production resources were altered. All check, 1,108 unit, 129 disposable DB suites passed locally; required exact-head GitHub CI will be rechecked after publishing.
newEngineering: Per-pass owner-selected bounded-rate input, validated issuance and exact persisted grant readback; additive oauth_tokens.rtc_requests_per_minute column with legacy default 60; guarded admission using existing cross-instance atomic Postgres minute meter and accurate Retry-After; safe whoami/one-time receipt; negative and two-adapter race/revocation tests, and current card/status/roadmap/owner/architecture/decisions documentation.
relatedWorkDecision: R-1 pass issuance and R-3 conformance are dependencies, but each remains its own full subsection with separate proof

Complete R-1 permission issuance and R-3 independent RTC conformance through their separate original plan boundaries.
Obtain independently verified real desktop/mobile OAuth, consent and released/provider behavior only under applicable owner production approvals.

criteria.criterion: Public RTC 2 manifest correct, versioned and truthful with counted tools and no unverified deployment SHA
criteria.evidence: The R-2 source branch retains RTC 1 until independent RTC 2 deployment/consumer cutover; release and client metadata have source tests, but no evidence of running RTC 2 production or independent revision agreement.

criteria.criterion: One authenticated effective pass principal across every HTTPS door, guarded writes, correct error envelopes and separation from MCP OAuth
criteria.evidence: requireRtcPass authorizes the limited existing read_only preview subset and rejects MCP OAuth bearers, revoked and forged grants. Complete RTC 2 full-authority/write-through and universal HTTPS guard equivalence remain unimplemented and unaccepted.

criteria.criterion: Cursor list and 1-based byte-exact bounded result recovery with grant isolation
criteria.evidence: Existing RTC 2 injected tests cover HMAC-bound discovery cursors and 1-based byte-exact UTF-8 result recovery; real released RTC 2 ingress and all pass scopes unverified.

criteria.criterion: Atomic 429 rate budget across two handlers, revocation, expiry and legacy pass handling
criteria.evidence: New R-2 extension: owner input, issuance and persistent row carry an integer 1..60 requests/minute, default 60 for existing passes. requireRtcPass validates stored cap and calls atomic PostgreSQL consumeApiBudget with exact pass hash; HTTP 429 exposes the remaining minute. Disposable PostgreSQL tests run 8 concurrent requests through two created DB adapters under limit 3: 3 accepted, 5 rejected, and the next call after revocation refused; see tests/db/rtc-passes.test.js. General RTC 2 pass lifecycle, quota scopes and released acceptance remain pending.

criteria.criterion: At most thirty real OpenAPI operations, native PKCE metadata and fixed resource identity
criteria.evidence: Current public RTC 1 OpenAPI remains bounded and a source-only PKCE/handoff exists; native actual client and authenticated RTC 2 advertised contract acceptance remain incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Same serving release identity across initialize, whoami, manifest, health and front door
criteria.evidence: Native initialize, manifest, whoami, health and the public entry have version/SHA metadata source handling, but exact running deployed SHA cross-endpoint and direct client verification have not passed.

criteria.criterion: Public mobile OAuth handoff without developer authentication confusion, backward-compatible old clients
criteria.evidence: Customer-facing mobile OAuth handoff and legacy route source tests exist; independent proof of customer versus backend-only developer grants and normal mobile sign-in is missing.

Full source checks, 1108 unit tests in 156 files, 129 isolated disposable PostgreSQL tests in 48 files pass after the pass-rate extension. Real fake-provider end-to-end RTC 2 write behavior, independent desktop/mobile clients, authorized deployed/provider acceptance and owner release remain missing.
